mentions.name: WordLlamaDetect
mentions.description: A language identification model that runs on CPU, processing 70k texts per second on a single thread with a 13MB model artifact. It supports 148 languages (~100 with good accuracy) and is trained as static embeddings derived from the Gemma 3 token embeddings.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m finishing up a language identification model that runs on cpu, 70k texts/s single thread, 13mb model artifact and 148 supported languages (though only ~100 have good accuracy).
